_comment: The Carpentry Tools & Joints prototype build, described for ../lesson-kit/build.py. This is a CLIENT DEMONSTRATION: one lesson at full depth plus the module hub, not the whole module. Everything a page draws lives in the kit; this file holds only what is specific to the module.
_level: TVET carries levels, not grades, and levelKind is stated end to end so nothing downstream reads levelNumber as a school year — the trap Intensive English fell into by sending its CEFR level as `grade`. Learners here are at grade 8 to 11 level.
hubIntro: The families of wood joint, how a joint is marked out and cut, and how members are fastened and assembled. Theory, drawings and assessment are done here; every cut is made and signed off at the bench.
leadsNote: This is foundation work. It is not a unit of the Kenyan Carpentry & Joinery Level 4 qualification — all eight of those units assume you already have tools and joints. What you learn here is what they are built on: marking out, sawing to a line and fitting a joint feed directly into Doors and Windows (0732 351 05D), Timber Furniture Items (0732 351 06D) and Cabinets (0732 351 08D).
endNote: You have marked out and cut a halving joint on screen. The next one is in timber, at the bench, with an assessor watching — that is where the competency is signed off.
_extraScripts: kit.js loads first and carries the shared machinery. These two are carpentry's own: its drawings and step kinds, then the joint families, the fasteners and the sawing and paring sequences.
